input.summary:
P1 west cabinet furnished: one pink bed (foot 16,3,15, head 16,3,16 against the back wall z17, facing south) and a hanging lantern at 16,6,16 for light, lane 17,15..17,16 kept clear for both doors and the bed head.
Make.sh runs clean (exit 0, whole build.nbt), part reports 2 placed, no REFUSED or OFF-PALETTE; room.png reads as a bed in the west column of the cabinet.
Local check is not yet OK: walk is unreachable (the door and the house are not built in this copy) and the lantern is not placed because the roof part is skipped here, so the cells read dark (0) locally.
left: Lantern depends on the merged roof: hanging_lantern at (16,6,16) only writes its chain and lantern if a solid roof block sits within 4 cells above (y7..y10). Roof is laid before room parts in runParts, so it should land, but in this copy the roof is skipped and the cabinet reads light 0. Verify in the merged build with `$MCD room ... --only "P1 west cabinet"` (expect min 8+); if the roof underside is not solid there, a lantern needs a different anchor.
Walk verdict is UNREACHABLE only because the door (17,3..4,14) and the house are not built in this copy; re-run the room check once the shell and fittings are merged.

plan.md has no checklist ticks (no [ ] lines), and elements.md has no per-room item for this cabinet; the Plot 1 item '4 beds (east chamber 2, two cabinets 1 each)' is only one-quarter done by this part, so it is left unticked for the furnisher of the other rooms.

waste.what: Cell-by-cell working-out of the 2x2 floor (which cells are lane, which are bed, why 17,15 and 17,16 must stay clear) done by hand from the plan grid.
waste.cost: about 3 reasoning passes; no tool calls wasted
waste.tool: `$MCD plan` could print a per-cell 'lane' / 'bed-foot' / 'clear' marking, or a `room --suggest` that lists the cells a furniture piece may take without blocking a doorway or a bed head.

waste.what: Import confusion: bed() lives in the build library, hanging_lantern() in vocab; the first version failed at make.sh with a SyntaxError that also left a stale build.nbt, and the room check looked fine on the old file.
waste.cost: 2 failed make runs and 1 sed edit that broke on macOS; one stale-file false pass
waste.tool: vocab.mjs should re-export the build library's bed, B and shutter so a part imports from one place; make.sh should delete build.nbt before building, so a failed build cannot pass for a fresh one.

waste.what: Checking the light by hand: I had to infer the roof underside is solid at (16,8,16) since the roof is skipped in this copy.
